data.name: ARENA 3D
data.detailed_description:
Fast & Furious

Fast, frenetic, bright and colourful arcade action set within a seamless digital realm. Accompanied by a pounding soundtrack, ARENA 3D features multiple game modes and global leaderboards to see how you stack up against your friends.

If you love classic titles such as Geometry Wars, Super Stardust, Pac-man, Command & Conquer and many more.... then you'll love ARENA 3D.

ARENA 3D is currently being developed by just one person and the vision is to bring classic arcade genres into a bright, colourful and exciting digital world.

Play to support

Jump into the action now through Early Access and be a part of the team to help create an addictive arcade masterpiece. Straight away you can try out 3 different game modes, complete with online leaderboards to satisfy your competitive edge. The game modes available in the current build are as follows:

  • Exosphere - Fast paced and addictive twin stick bullet hell inspired by Geometry Wars & Super Stardust
  • Fathom - Test your fear of the dark with this Pac-man inspired nightmare. You can run, but can you hide?
  • Commander - Crossing Geometry Wars with Gears of War Horde has led to the creation of this tower defence game mode. Build your defences and survive.

Upcoming Features

ARENA 3D has some exciting features already in development and with the help from the community, we can bring them to life in the best possible way.

There are more game modes to come:

  • Velocity - High speed endless runner. Test your reflexes to see just how far you can get
  • Stranded - Fly in three dimensions as you take to the digital sky to defend your base
  • Tower - First person missile defence. Perfect your aim and annihilate your enemies

Arcade games are traditionally best enjoyed with other players and ARENA 3D has a prototype multiplayer system already, which will be released in the future as part of Early Access to work closely with the community to refine.

Already an addictive title to play, there are a few more extras in development to keep players coming back. The Dock section is under development which has an area to customise and unlock new ships and designs by completing challenges.

Also in the Dock will be an area to unlock upgrades for your ship in each game mode category, so you can keep chasing that ever increasing high score.

No game is complete without achievements, and the Medals area will display unique high quality and detailed 3D medals for each achievement that you unlock.

Enter the ARENA.

data.short_description: Fast paced, bright and colourful arcade action accompanied by a pounding soundtrack.

reviews.review: This is exactly my genre, Geometry Wars 3 is one of my favorite games and this boasts the same design sensibility and general gameplay. However, it's quite a bit buggy and also completely abandoned. I ran into a bug because of non-standard resolution (1680x1050) that completely blocks my progress at third level, reported it here https://steamcommunity.com/app/438460/discussions/0/5532118063954838972/ and waited for half a year, now I think I'm entitled to give it a negative review. If you run it at standard FHD resolution, I imagine you'll still run into a bug or two, but a game-breaking bug that multiple users report and that's not fixed for half a year is kind of inexcusable. I think the author simply bit off more than they're willing to chew afterwards, what with making it practically on their own in Unity. A shame, really. I won't request a refund since it costs as much as a craft beer and also the only other dude making games in this genre (Waves^2) died and I feel ready to throw that kind of money at anyone trying anything with abstract twin stick shooters at this point. Also, I'll probably get another monitor sometime in the future and it might work after that but I wanted to share it's really caveat emptor in here.
